verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an API-first, hosted email provider, and nothing in the evidence describes its own offline mode, local cache, or reconnect-and-sync behavior. IMAP/SMTP support lets third-party clients such as Thunderbird connect, and those clients may work offline. That offline behavior belongs to external clients, so it is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
